youtube.baslik: Why can someone who hears vowels still confuse them? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Most vowel energy lies below 1000 Hz, so even people with high-frequency hearing loss usually hear vowels well. But telling vowels apart also needs the second formant, which rises above 2000 Hz in front vowels such as ee.
